Name: TUTORIAL_PARAM_ST
Description: Tutorial pop-ups. A row is shown when the game requests it by ID (events, menus) or when a menu with a matching Trigger Menu opens; it needs its unlock flag on and, for a once-only row, not to have been seen. Rows can be a toast (small, closes on a timer) or a modal window (title, body and image; closes when dismissed). Modal rows also appear in a menu's Help list.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail sets it on 22 rows (DLC and online topics).

Fields.Name: Display Type
Fields.Description: How the tutorial is shown. 0: toast, one-line layout. 1: toast, multi-line layout. 100: modal window with image; it takes priority over a toast, which is closed and shown again afterwards. Other values: never shown. Only modal rows are listed in a menu's Help list.

Fields.Name: Trigger Menu
Fields.Description: Menu that shows this tutorial when it opens (it is queued along with every other row with the same value), and whose Help list includes it (modal rows only). 0: none, the tutorial only appears when requested by ID. Retail: 2 Equipment, 3 Item Crafting, 4 Inventory, 5 Status, 6 Message, 7 Multiplayer, 8 Map, 9 Level Up, 12 Flask Allocation, 13 Memorize Spells, 14 Chest, 32 Shop, 35 Remembrance Duplication, 37 Remnant Crafting, 39 Ashes of War, 40 Spirit Tuning, 41 Smithing, 64 Great Rune, 65 Physick Mixing, 70 Rebirth, 100 Colosseum.

Fields.Name: Repeat Type
Fields.Description: 0: show once. When shown, the row is recorded in the save file and is never shown again. 1: not recorded, so it can be shown again every time it is requested.

Fields.Name: Image ID
Fields.Description: Picture shown in the modal window. 0: no picture. Toasts don't show it.

Fields.Name: Unlock Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag that must be on for the tutorial to show (requests are ignored while it's off). 0 or -1: always allowed. In a Help list, a row is listed only while this flag is on.

Fields.Name: Text ID
Fields.Description: Text of the tutorial: the title is TutorialTitle and the body is TutorialBody, both with this ID.

Fields.Name: Minimum Display Time
Fields.Description: Toast only: when the toast is closed early, it stays on screen until it has been shown for at least this long (seconds). Retail: 1 on all rows.

Fields.Name: Display Time
Fields.Description: Toast only: the toast closes by itself after this many seconds. Retail: 2.5 to 4.5.
